sceneState.before: A small, cylindrical brushed stainless steel gadget sits on a light grey quartz countertop amidst scattered baking supplies. A single, recessed button is visible on its top surface.
sceneState.action: A hand presses the recessed button, initiating a smooth clockwise rotation of the gadget.
sceneState.after: The gadget has rotated 90 degrees clockwise, revealing a portion of its side.

shots.narration: This compact gadget reveals a surprisingly bright, warm light source within.

sceneState.before: The gadget has rotated 90 degrees clockwise, revealing a portion of its side.
sceneState.action: The gadget completes its rotation, and a large panel seamlessly slides open, revealing a warm, golden glow from a small cylindrical lamp within.
sceneState.after: The gadget has completed its rotation, and a large panel is fully open, revealing a warm, golden glow from a small cylindrical lamp.
